observations.contract: Early-warning endpoint requires view_logs; merchant-identifying health rows additionally require view_merchants. This text names the endpoint, not all administrative audit references.
view_logs and view_merchants are independent explicit assistant permissions; no detailed generic incident metadata redaction policy is specified here.

Generic view_logs projection selects merchant-linked audit events, joined merchant names and whole metadata; emergency audit is separately owner-gated. Merchant early-warning events meet merchant_id predicate. Source observation, no new HTTP execution.

decision.question: May view_logs-only readers see merchant-scoped early-warning health/value metadata through general audit history, or should these rows/details also require view_merchants?
decision.reason: Endpoint-specific health visibility and established global audit references do not alone establish one uniform cross-consumer policy.
options: Retain ordinary merchant audit references but additionally gate merchant early-warning incident rows by view_merchants
Explicitly allow incident audit metadata under view_logs while documenting the endpoint-specific distinction
decision.notInferred: No new confirmed vulnerability, intentionality theorem or authorization-policy adoption from source alone.
